title: 卡萨丁·紫甲关隘
description: 卡萨丁戴标志呼吸面罩与角盔，完整紫色护甲覆盖身体，在宽阔关隘静立，腕刃收回，深浅硬边光面清楚。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Kassadin is an adult armored wanderer with a distinctive horned purple helmet, a dark breathing mask, luminous blue-violet eye slits, and layered Void-touched armor. Preserve his broad shoulder and covered-face silhouette with a fully covering opaque tunic, gauntlets, trousers, and boots. His energy blade is fully retracted into the wrist housing, and no exposed chest, cutting glow, or attack posture appears.
art_direction.scene: He stands squarely before an immense open mountain gate, arms lowered and feet firmly apart, watching distant geometric rock formations. The wrist housing remains clear and inactive. A concentrated cool side beam carves the armor into angular coarse wax-crayon planes, opposed by a narrow warm edge, while simple receding steps and pale empty distance reinforce the composed explorer silhouette.
art_direction.palette: deep purple, blue-violet light, sandstone, charcoal
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
